$comment: The one machine-readable description of Atelier's mod API. sdk/generate.mjs turns it into sdk/atelier.d.ts and sdk/manifest.schema.json; the atelier-mod CLI, the in-app Playground templates and the website's API page read it too. Types are TypeScript type expressions. Entries added in a release carry "since". Keep it in step with Sources/DockCore/Plugin*.swift: Tests/DockCoreTests/PluginAPIDescriptionTests.swift fails when the app has a permission, event, view or manifest key this file does not list.
name: Atelier plugin API

ids.description: Every registration takes an id of letters, digits, -, _ or . (up to 64). Without one, Atelier makes one from the title ("Say Hello" becomes say-hello). Registering the same id again updates it.

colors.description: A colour is #RRGGBB hex or one of Atelier's named inks. "accent" follows the widget style, so a plugin matches whatever theme is on.

permissions.name: network
permissions.title: Network
permissions.detail: Exchange data over https with the sites listed below. Nothing else on the network.
permissions.notes: https only, standard port, only hosts listed in network.hosts, redirects may not leave them, 2 MB per response, 4 requests at once, 15 s timeout, no cookies or cache. Also image views with a url.

permissions.name: notifications
permissions.title: Notifications
permissions.notes: macOS asks once for Atelier itself.

permissions.name: openURL
permissions.title: Open Links
permissions.detail: Open web and mail links in your default apps.
permissions.notes: https: and mailto: links, and atelier://studio.

permissions.name: appearance
permissions.title: Change Appearance
permissions.detail: Change Atelier theme settings: colours, wallpaper, Dock and widget style. You can revert them.
permissions.notes: Any theme key; validated like a theme; Revert in Looks undoes it.

permissions.name: menuBar
permissions.title: Menu Bar
permissions.detail: Show an item in the menu bar, with its own menu. At most two.
permissions.notes: Up to 2 items; Atelier owns the item, its menu names the plugin.

permissions.name: liveActivities
permissions.title: Live Activities
permissions.detail: Show small live updates at the top of the screen, like a timer or a download. At most three.
permissions.notes: Pills under the menu bar; 3 show at once.

permissions.name: scenes
permissions.title: Scenes
permissions.detail: See the names of your Scenes and switch to one, which changes your Dock.
permissions.notes: Lists Scene names and switches to one.

permissions.name: panels
permissions.title: Windows
permissions.detail: Open its own small windows. They show the plugin's page with no network and no access to your files.
permissions.notes: The plugin's HTML, no network, no files outside its folder.

limits.title: Script size
limits.description: The entry script may be at most 512 KB.

limits.title: Time per call
limits.description: Each call into a plugin (loading, a timer, a click, a render) may run 1 s. Three timeouts in a row stop the plugin.

limits.title: Registrations
limits.description: Widgets, tiles, commands and corner actions together, per plugin.

limits.title: View size
limits.description: Nodes in one view tree.

limits.title: View depth
limits.description: How deep views may nest.

limits.title: Text length
limits.description: Longer texts in views are cut.

limits.title: Sparkline points
limits.description: The last 240 values are kept.

limits.title: List rows
limits.description: Rows in one list view.

limits.title: Storage
limits.description: All stored values together.

limits.title: Storage key length
limits.description: Keys are 1 to 128 characters.

limits.title: Message size
limits.description: One call across the bridge, as JSON.

limits.title: Requests at once
limits.description: Network requests in flight per plugin.

limits.title: Response size
limits.description: Per network response.

limits.title: Request timeout
limits.description: Per network request.

limits.title: Timers
limits.description: setTimeout and setInterval timers at once.

limits.title: Timer events
limits.description: atelier.on("timer") subscriptions.

limits.title: Network hosts
limits.description: Entries in network.hosts.

limits.title: Prompt interval
limits.description: atelier.prompt may ask at most once every 10 seconds.

limits.title: Plugin package
limits.description: A plugin zips to at most 2 MB in the catalog.

limits.title: Theme package
limits.description: A theme zips to at most 40 MB in the catalog.

limits.title: Settings
limits.description: Entries in the manifest's settings list.

limits.title: Plugin messages
limits.description: One atelier.send payload, as JSON.

limits.title: Assets
limits.description: One png, jpg, jpeg, heic or pdf image in the plugin folder.

limits.title: Chart series
limits.description: Series in one chart view.

limits.title: Chart values
limits.description: The last 120 values of a series are kept.

limits.title: Languages
limits.description: Languages in the manifest's strings.

limits.title: Strings
limits.description: Keys per language in the manifest's strings.

limits.title: Palette providers
limits.description: atelier.paletteProvider registrations per plugin.

limits.title: Palette rows
limits.description: Rows kept from one search answer, which must come within 1 s.

limits.title: Menu bar items
limits.description: atelier.menuBarItem registrations per plugin; text up to 16 characters.

limits.title: Menu items
limits.description: Items in one menu, submenus included; menus nest 2 levels.

limits.title: Drops
limits.description: A link or text dropped on a tile.

limits.title: Stack providers
limits.description: atelier.stackProvider registrations per plugin.

limits.title: Stack items
limits.description: Items kept from one answer, which must come within 4 s.

limits.title: Live activities
limits.description: Activities shown at once.

limits.title: Panels
limits.description: atelier.panel registrations per plugin.

limits.title: Panel page
limits.description: A panel's html.

limits.title: Panel messages
limits.description: One message to or from a panel, as JSON.

manifest.description: Reverse-DNS identifier, unique to the plugin: com.example.pomodoro. Permanent: updates follow it.
What it does, in a sentence or two.
The script Atelier runs, a path inside the plugin folder. At most 512 KB.
An SF Symbol name for the plugin.
An https link to the plugin's page or source.
What it asks for. The owner grants each one separately.
Hosts the http functions and image views may reach, like api.github.com. No schemes, paths, ports, wildcards, local or private addresses. Required with the network permission.
Settings Atelier draws for the plugin, on its page in Mods and in its details in Mods › Library. Read and write them with atelier.settings; changes arrive as the settingsChanged event.

When the script starts. Leave it out to start at launch. Without onStartup the script waits for onCommand, onWidgetVisible, onTileClick, onCorner, onTimer (with contributes.timer) or onEvent:<event>; what contributes declares shows meanwhile.

What shows before the script runs, with activation: widgets, tiles (id, title, symbol), commands and corner actions, checked like registrations; timer is how often onTimer wakes it, in seconds. The script must still register them with the same ids.
Localized text for atelier.t, by language code: { "en": { "hello": "Hello" }, "pt": { "hello": "Olá" } }. Up to 24 languages and 400 keys each, values up to 1000 characters.
Plugin ids this one may send to and hear from. A message is delivered only when the sender lists the receiver under send and the receiver lists the sender under receive.

types.name: Permission
types.description: A permission a plugin may ask for in its manifest.

types.name: Color
types.description: #RRGGBB hex or a named ink. "accent" follows the widget style.

types.name: Awaitable
types.description: A value, or a Promise of one: callbacks may be async.

types.name: WidgetSize
types.description: The size a widget prefers on the board.

types.name: WidgetSpec
types.description: A widget for the board. Add it with the Plugin widget kind and choose it from the list.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Defaults to one made from the title.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Shown above the content and in the picker.

properties.name: size
properties.description: The size it prefers.

properties.name: refresh
properties.description: Seconds between runs of data and view, 5 to 86400.

properties.name: data
properties.description: Fetches or computes data. May be async.

properties.name: view
properties.description: Turns data into a view. If missing, data's result is drawn as the view.

types.name: WidgetHandle
types.description: What atelier.widget returns.

properties.name: id
properties.description: The widget's id.

properties.name: refresh
properties.description: Runs data and view again now, for example after a click elsewhere changed your state.

types.name: TileSpec
types.description: A tile for the Atelier Dock.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Defaults to one made from the title.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The tile's name under the pointer.

properties.name: symbol
properties.description: An SF Symbol for the icon.

properties.name: text
properties.description: Up to 12 characters drawn under or instead of the symbol: "24:59".

properties.name: badge
properties.description: A red badge of up to 4 characters; null hides it.

properties.name: tint
properties.description: The tile's colour.

properties.name: progress
properties.description: 0 to 1: a ring around the tile.

properties.name: onClick
properties.description: Runs when the tile is clicked.

properties.name: menu
properties.description: Its right-click (and press-and-hold) menu, above Atelier's own items.

properties.name: accepts
properties.description: What may be dropped on it. Files never are.

properties.name: onDrop
properties.description: Runs when a link or text it accepts is dropped on it.

types.name: TileHandle
types.description: What atelier.dockTile returns.

properties.name: id
properties.description: The tile's id.

properties.name: update
properties.description: Merges the changes into the tile and redraws it. Cheap: updating every second is fine.

types.name: CommandSpec
types.description: An entry in Atelier's Command palette.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Defaults to one made from the title.

properties.name: title
properties.description: What the palette shows.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: Defaults to the plugin's name.

properties.name: shortcut
properties.description: Shown beside the entry, like "ctrl+opt+p" or "cmd+shift+k": at least one of cmd, ctrl, opt; keys are one character, space, return, tab, escape or f1 to f20. Shown, not bound globally.

properties.name: run
properties.description: Runs when the command is chosen.

types.name: CornerActionSpec
types.description: An action for a hot corner or edge in Atelier's Corners chapter.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Defaults to one made from the title.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Shown in the Corners picker.

properties.name: symbol
properties.description: An SF Symbol.

properties.name: run
properties.description: Runs when the corner fires.

types.name: OnOptions
types.description: Options for atelier.on.

properties.name: interval
properties.description: For the timer event: seconds between events, 5 to 86400.

types.name: HttpOptions
types.description: Options for atelier.http.get.

properties.name: headers
properties.description: Ordinary headers such as Authorization and Accept. Cookie, Host, Origin, Referer, Content-Length and Connection are dropped.

types.name: HttpResponse
types.description: A frozen response. ok is true for 200 to 299; other statuses still resolve, so check ok.

properties.name: status
properties.description: The HTTP status.

properties.name: ok
properties.description: True for status 200 to 299.

properties.name: text
properties.description: The body as text.

properties.name: headers
properties.description: Response headers, lowercased.

properties.name: json
properties.description: Parses text as JSON.

types.name: PromptOptions
types.description: Options for atelier.prompt.

properties.name: message
properties.description: A sentence under the title.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Grey text in the empty field.

properties.name: secure
properties.description: Hides what is typed. Use it for tokens.

types.name: NotifySpec
types.description: A notification.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Cut at 80 characters.

properties.name: body
properties.description: Cut at 240 characters.

types.name: ThemePatch
types.description: Any theme keys from THEMES.md, without format, id, name or version.

types.name: HttpSendOptions
types.description: Options for atelier.http.post, put, patch and delete.

properties.name: headers
properties.description: As for get. Cookie, Host, Origin, Referer, Content-Length and Connection are dropped.

properties.name: body
properties.description: The body, as text.

properties.name: json
properties.description: Any JSON value, sent with Content-Type: application/json unless you set one.

types.name: Action
types.description: What a button, toggle or menu item runs: a function, or an id registered with atelier.action.

types.name: ToggleChange
types.description: What a toggle's action receives.

properties.name: on
properties.description: The toggle's new state.

types.name: MenuItem
types.description: A choice in a menu. Without an action it shows greyed out, which suits a status line.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Up to 80 characters.

properties.name: symbol
properties.description: An SF Symbol.

properties.name: action
properties.description: Runs when the item is chosen.

properties.name: checked
properties.description: Draws a check mark.

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: False greys it out.

properties.name: submenu
properties.description: One level of submenus, instead of an action.

types.name: MenuEntry
types.description: An item, or "separator" (or "-") for a line; any other text is refused. A menu holds at most 40 entries in all.

types.name: Drop
types.description: What a tile's onDrop receives.

properties.name: kind
properties.description: An http, https or mailto link, or text.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The link or text, at most 8 KB.

types.name: ResultRow
types.description: A row a palette provider or stack provider answers with.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Up to 120 characters. Rows without a title are skipped.

properties.name: subtitle
properties.description: A second line.

properties.name: symbol
properties.description: An SF Symbol.

properties.name: image
properties.description: A PNG or JPEG in the plugin folder, by relative path.

properties.name: action
properties.description: Runs when the row is chosen.

types.name: PaletteProviderSpec
types.description: Rows in the Command palette as the owner types.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Defaults to one made from the title.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The section title in the palette.

properties.name: prefix
properties.description: 1 to 12 characters, no spaces. With "gh", asked only for queries starting with "gh ", and given the rest.

properties.name: search
properties.description: Up to 20 rows, within 1 s. Asked 120 ms after typing stops.

types.name: MenuBarItemSpec
types.description: An item in the menu bar, owned by Atelier.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Defaults to one made from the title.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Its tooltip and accessibility name.

properties.name: symbol
properties.description: An SF Symbol. A symbol, a text or both.

properties.name: text
properties.description: Up to 16 characters beside the symbol.

properties.name: menu
properties.description: The menu that opens on click.

types.name: MenuBarHandle
types.description: What atelier.menuBarItem returns.

properties.name: id
properties.description: The item's id.

properties.name: update
properties.description: Merges the changes and redraws it, menu included.

properties.name: remove
properties.description: Takes it out of the menu bar.

types.name: StackProviderSpec
types.description: A stack on the Atelier Dock whose items come from the plugin.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Defaults to one made from the title.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The stack's name.

properties.name: symbol
properties.description: An SF Symbol.

properties.name: refresh
properties.description: Seconds an answer is reused, 0 to 86400. 0 asks every time the stack opens.

properties.name: items
properties.description: Up to 60 rows, within 4 s.

types.name: StackHandle
types.description: What atelier.stackProvider returns.

properties.name: id
properties.description: The stack's id.

properties.name: refresh
properties.description: Makes the next opening ask again.

types.name: LiveActivitySpec
types.description: A small live pill under the menu bar.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Defaults to one made from the title.

properties.name: title
properties.description: What is happening.

properties.name: symbol
properties.description: An SF Symbol.

properties.name: text
properties.description: Up to 60 characters. With until and no text, it counts down.

properties.name: progress
properties.description: 0 to 1: a bar in tint.

properties.name: tint
properties.description: The bar's colour.

properties.name: until
properties.description: When it ends by itself: a Date, an ISO date or ms since 1970.

properties.name: onTap
properties.description: Runs when it is clicked.

types.name: LiveActivityHandle
types.description: What atelier.liveActivity returns.

properties.name: id
properties.description: The activity's id.

properties.name: update
properties.description: Merges the changes and redraws it.

properties.name: end
properties.description: Removes it.

types.name: PanelSpec
types.description: A small floating window showing the plugin's HTML, sealed off: no network, files from its folder only, no navigation.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Defaults to one made from the title. The same id again replaces the page.

properties.name: title
properties.description: The window's title.

properties.name: width
properties.description: 200 to 1200 points.

properties.name: height
properties.description: 120 to 900 points.

properties.name: html
properties.description: The page, at most 512 KB. Inside it, window.atelier.post(message) and window.atelier.onMessage(fn).

properties.name: resizable
properties.description: Whether the owner can resize it.

properties.name: onMessage
properties.description: Messages the page posts. They also arrive as the panelMessage event.

types.name: PanelHandle
types.description: What atelier.panel returns.

properties.name: id
properties.description: The panel's id.

properties.name: show
properties.description: Brings it up without taking focus from the app in front.

properties.name: hide
properties.description: Hides it.

properties.name: post
properties.description: Sends JSON (up to 64 KB) to the page's onMessage.

types.name: Scene
types.description: One of the owner's Scenes.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Its name, as atelier.scenes.apply takes it.

types.name: SettingSpec
types.description: One setting in the manifest's settings list.

properties.name: key
properties.description: Letters, digits, - _ or ., up to 64.

properties.name: type
properties.description: text (up to 1000 characters), secret (kept in the Keychain, never shown again), number (with min and max), toggle, choice (with options), color (#RRGGBB), hotkeyHint (a shortcut like cmd+shift+p, shown as a hint, not bound).

properties.name: title
properties.description: 1 to 60 characters.

properties.name: detail
properties.description: A line under the title, up to 200 characters.

properties.name: default
properties.description: The value before the owner changes it. A secret has none.

properties.name: options
properties.description: For choice, up to 40.

properties.name: min
properties.description: For number.

properties.name: max
properties.description: For number.

types.name: Activation
types.description: A trigger in the manifest's activation list.

types.name: Contributes
types.description: The manifest's contributes block.

properties.name: widgets
properties.type: Array<{ id: string; title?: string; size?: WidgetSize; refresh?: number }>
properties.description: Board widgets.

properties.name: tiles
properties.type: Array<{ id: string; title?: string; symbol?: string }>
properties.description: Dock tiles.

properties.name: commands
properties.type: Array<{ id: string; title: string; subtitle?: string; shortcut?: string }>
properties.description: Command palette entries.

properties.name: cornerActions
properties.type: Array<{ id: string; title: string; symbol?: string }>
properties.description: Hot corner actions.

properties.name: timer
properties.description: With onTimer: how often to wake it, 60 to 86400 seconds.

types.name: ChartSeries
types.description: One series in a chart.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Up to 40 characters.

properties.name: values
properties.description: The last 120 are kept.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Its colour.

api.name: atelier.version
api.description: The API version, currently "1.1".

api.name: atelier.widget
api.description: Registers a widget for the board. Add it with the Plugin widget kind.

api.name: atelier.dockTile
api.description: Registers a tile for the Atelier Dock.
api.example: const tile = atelier.dockTile({ id: "timer", title: "Timer", symbol: "timer", text: "25:00", onClick: () => tile.update({ badge: 1 }) });

api.name: atelier.command
api.description: Adds an entry to Atelier's Command palette.
api.example: atelier.command({ title: "Say Hello", shortcut: "ctrl+opt+h", run: () => console.log("Hello!") });

api.name: atelier.cornerAction
api.description: Adds an action you can put on a hot corner or edge in the Corners chapter.
api.example: atelier.cornerAction({ title: "Shuffle Palette", symbol: "dice", run: shuffle });

api.name: atelier.on
api.description: Listens for an event. See Events.
api.example:
atelier.on("appActivated", ({ name }) => console.log(name + " is in front"));
atelier.on("timer", () => w.refresh(), { interval: 300 });

api.name: atelier.notify
api.description: Posts a notification. Titles are cut at 80 characters, bodies at 240.
api.example: atelier.notify("Focus session done", "Take five.");

api.name: atelier.openURL
api.description: Opens an https: or mailto: link in its default app, or an atelier://studio?chapter=… link.
api.example: atelier.openURL("https://github.com/notifications");

api.name: atelier.prompt

returns.description: The text, or null if the owner cancels.

api.description: Asks the owner for one line of text in a small Atelier window with your plugin's name on it. At most once every 10 seconds.
api.example: const token = await atelier.prompt("GitHub token", { secure: true, placeholder: "ghp_…" });

api.name: atelier.storage
api.description: A small key-value store of JSON values, private to the plugin and kept across launches. Keys are 1 to 128 characters; all values together at most 256 KB.

api.name: atelier.storage.get
api.description: The value, or fallback (default null).
api.example: let count = atelier.storage.get("count", 0);

api.name: atelier.storage.set
api.description: Stores any JSON value. null or undefined removes the key. Saved within a second and when the plugin stops.
api.example: atelier.storage.set("count", count + 1);

api.name: atelier.storage.remove
api.description: Removes the key.

api.name: atelier.storage.keys
api.description: All keys, sorted.

api.name: atelier.http
api.description: https requests to the hosts in the manifest's network.hosts. Every request is logged in the Console with its status and timing. The user agent is Atelier-Plugin/1.1 (<your id>).

api.name: atelier.http.get

returns.description: Rejects on network failures, refused hosts and oversized responses.

api.description: Fetches a URL on a listed host.
api.example:
const r = await atelier.http.get("https://api.github.com/notifications", { headers: { Authorization: "Bearer " + token } });
if (r.ok) console.log(r.json().length);

api.name: atelier.theme
api.description: Changing Atelier's theme.

api.name: atelier.theme.apply
api.description: Applies part of a theme. Validated like a theme and refused whole if anything is wrong. The first change from a plugin saves the owner's setup, so Revert in Looks undoes it.
api.example: atelier.theme.apply({ colors: { accent: "#FF8A3D" }, wallpaper: { shader: "nebula", palette: "ember" } });

api.name: atelier.ui
api.description: Helpers that build view objects. Each takes the view's main value and an optional style object with the view's other keys. See Views.

api.name: atelier.http.post
api.description: Sends a POST, with the same rules and limits as get. body is text; json is any JSON value, sent with Content-Type application/json unless you set one.
api.example: await atelier.http.post("https://api.example.com/items", { json: { title: "Hello" } });

api.name: atelier.http.put
api.description: Sends a PUT, with the same rules and limits as get. body is text; json is any JSON value, sent with Content-Type application/json unless you set one.

api.name: atelier.http.patch
api.description: Sends a PATCH, with the same rules and limits as get. body is text; json is any JSON value, sent with Content-Type application/json unless you set one.

api.name: atelier.http.delete
api.description: Sends a DELETE, with the same rules and limits as get. body is text; json is any JSON value, sent with Content-Type application/json unless you set one.

api.name: atelier.action

returns.description: The id, to use as a view's action.

api.description: Registers a named action for buttons and toggles. A view's action may also be a function; the prelude gives it an id per widget, replaced on every render. A tap calls it once; call widget.refresh() after to redraw.
api.example:
atelier.action("reset", () => { count = 0; widget.refresh(); });
atelier.ui.button("Reset", "reset", { style: "plain" })

api.name: atelier.asset
api.description: Checks that a png, jpg, jpeg, heic or pdf of at most 2 MB is in the plugin's own folder and returns its path, or throws. Use it for image views.
api.example: atelier.ui.image(atelier.asset("images/logo.png"), { width: 48, height: 48, radius: 8 })

api.name: atelier.t
api.description: Localized text from the manifest's strings, in the owner's first preferred language the plugin has (pt-BR, then pt), then English, then the key itself. {name} is replaced from vars.
api.example: atelier.t("today", { n: 3 })

api.name: atelier.settings
api.description: The settings declared in the manifest. Values live in the plugin's storage under settings.<key> (storage.set refuses those keys); secrets live in the Keychain.

api.name: atelier.settings.get

returns.description: The value, or its default, or null.

api.description: Reads a declared setting. Throws for a key the manifest does not declare.
api.example: const minutes = atelier.settings.get("focus");

api.name: atelier.settings.set
api.description: Writes a declared setting, checked against its type; throws if it does not fit. null resets it to its default.

api.name: atelier.settings.all
api.description: Every declared setting's value, by key.

api.name: atelier.send

params.name: payload
params.description: Any JSON value, up to 64 KB.

api.description: Sends a message to another plugin. It arrives there as the message event only when this plugin lists it under messages.send, it lists this one under messages.receive, and it is on. Undelivered messages are noted in this plugin's Console.
api.example: atelier.send("com.example.timer", { start: 25 });

api.name: atelier.paletteProvider
api.description: Answers in Atelier's Command palette as the owner types. Each plugin's rows show in a section of their own. At most 4 per plugin.

api.name: atelier.menuBarItem
api.description: An item in the menu bar showing a symbol, a text or both; clicking it opens its menu. At most two per plugin.
api.example:
const item = atelier.menuBarItem({ id: "focus", symbol: "timer", text: "25:00", menu: [
  { title: "Start", action: () => start() }, "separator", { title: "3 done today" }] });

api.name: atelier.stackProvider
api.description: A stack the owner can put on the Atelier Dock (Stacks › From Plugins). Clicking it asks items and opens the usual stack bubble. At most 4 per plugin.
api.example:
atelier.stackProvider({ id: "prs", title: "Pull Requests", symbol: "arrow.triangle.pull", refresh: 300,
  items: async () => prs.map((p) => ({ title: p.title, subtitle: p.repo, action: () => atelier.openURL(p.url) })) });

api.name: atelier.liveActivity
api.description: A small live pill under the menu bar, drawn like Atelier's HUD. At most three show at once; a fourth is refused until one ends.

api.name: atelier.scenes
api.description: The owner's Scenes.

api.name: atelier.scenes.list
api.description: The owner's Scenes, by name.

api.name: atelier.scenes.apply
api.description: Switches to that Scene, as choosing it in the Scenes chapter does. A snapshot is kept, so Snapshots can undo it.
api.example:
const [first] = await atelier.scenes.list();
if (first) await atelier.scenes.apply(first.name);

api.name: atelier.panel
api.description: A small floating window showing your HTML: no network, files from your folder only, no navigation or popups, nothing kept. At most 4 per plugin.

views.description: Text. A plain string or number in a view is drawn as text too.
An SF Symbol, with the text keys for its size and colour.

props.name: name
props.description: An SF Symbol name, like timer.

views.description: A ring that fills from 0 to 1, with an optional label in the middle.
A small line chart of recent values.

props.name: items
props.description: Strings, or rows with title, detail, symbol and color.

views.description: Children top to bottom. An array in a view is a vstack too.

props.name: transition
props.description: Children that appear or disappear between renders animate this way.

props.name: transition
props.description: Children that appear or disappear between renders animate this way.

views.description: Children on top of each other.

props.name: children
props.description: The views inside, back to front.

props.name: transition
props.description: Children that appear or disappear between renders animate this way.

views.description: A button. A tap runs its action once, under the usual 1-second limit.

props.name: title
props.description: Its text. A title, a symbol or both.

props.name: action
props.description: A function, or an id registered with atelier.action.

views.description: A switch. Its action receives { on } with the new state; redraw to show it.
views.example: atelier.ui.toggle("Do not disturb", dnd, ({ on }) => { dnd = on; widget.refresh(); })

views.description: An image from the plugin folder (asset) or an https url on a host in network.hosts (needs network). The helper takes either and picks the key.

props.name: asset
props.description: A png, jpg, jpeg, heic or pdf in the plugin folder, at most 2 MB.

props.name: url
props.description: An https image; Atelier fetches it with the rules of http.get.

views.description: A bar, line or area chart. The helper takes values, or a list of series.

props.name: values
props.description: One series; the last 120 are kept.

props.name: series
props.description: Up to 8 series instead of values.

props.name: labels
props.description: Along the x axis, up to 24 characters each.

views.description: Children in columns, row by row.
A linear bar with its percentage.

listRow.name: symbol
listRow.description: An SF Symbol before the title.

events.name: appActivated
events.description: Another app comes to the front.

events.name: wallpaperChanged
events.payload: { live?: string | null; mesh?: string | null }
events.description: Atelier changes the live or mesh wallpaper. A wallpaper picked in System Settings is not seen.

events.name: themeChanged
events.description: A theme or Look is applied, or reverted (id is null).

events.name: timer
events.description: Every options.interval seconds, 5 to 86400, default 60. Up to 4 per plugin. date is ms since 1970.

events.name: update
events.description: Once, after the plugin was updated, before any other handler runs.

events.name: settingsChanged
events.description: The owner changed a setting. value is null for secrets; read them with settings.get.

events.name: message
events.description: Another plugin sent a message with atelier.send.

events.name: displaysChanged
events.description: A display is added, removed or rearranged.

events.name: powerSource
events.description: The power source or battery level changes. level is 0 to 1, or null without a battery.

events.name: panelMessage
events.description: One of the plugin's panels called window.atelier.post(message).

globals.name: setTimeout
globals.description: Runs handler once after ms milliseconds. Up to 64 timers at once.

globals.name: setInterval
globals.description: Runs handler every ms milliseconds, at least 1000.

console.description: Writes to the Console in Mods › Library (and the Playground's console). Every error carries its line number.

kinds.title: Plugin
kinds.description: JavaScript that adds widgets, Dock tiles, commands, corner actions and more.

kinds.title: Theme
kinds.description: One file that restyles everything Atelier reaches. Format in THEMES.md.

kinds.title: Icon pack
kinds.description: App icons in the Atelier Dock, Orbit, the Launcher and Command, plus folders, Downloads and the Trash.

kinds.title: Sound pack
kinds.description: The Dock's sounds, the timer chime, the theme sound, and Typing Sounds.

kinds.title: Shader pack
kinds.description: A Live Wallpaper: one of Atelier's built-in shaders, recoloured and retuned. No shader code.

kinds.title: Layout pack
kinds.description: Snap layouts for Window Engine (Shift-drag zones).

kinds.title: Effect pack
kinds.description: Minimise effects for the Atelier Dock, as numbers on a built-in mesh.

kinds.title: Look
kinds.description: A theme, a wallpaper, Dock settings, and an icon and sound pack, at once.
